couplings.aligned: the row hit — nothing to explain
couplings.na: the row could not be scored (unfilled slot)
couplings.confirmed: miss/partial AND the detector has unregistered entries on the same axis — the third reading explains the miss
couplings.bare: miss/partial with NO detector entry on the axis — lens or measurement error, or a divergence deeper than the detector names
couplings.blind: miss/partial on a prediction the detector cannot see (the 9-row blind spot) — the operator lens is the only witness

identity_couplings.suspicious: no-match + zero unregistered — the judge sees differences the detector cannot name; check the blind axes
identity_couplings.refused-contradiction: known-release + unregistered content — impossible by the fw41 coverage proof; exit 2

profiles.clean: the image IS a known release, exactly
profiles.stranger: no-match + the detector names the residue
profiles.refused: an instrument disagreement — no profile claimed
profiles.clean-pair: a routine pair: zero births, zero deaths
profiles.event-pair: a pair with births/deaths — registered or beyond-register
